entry.title: Your Agent Forgot Again: A Cross-Session Memory Restart Checklist
entry.summary: If your agent forgets a project decision after a restart, test four things separately: was the decision saved, did the next session open the intended memory store, was the decision retrieved, and did the agent use it? Treat these as separate checks rather than taking a successful installation as proof of working memory. This guide proposes a small acceptance test you can adapt to your own setup. It does not rank memory products or promise a retrieval success rate. Use a synthetic project convention, not a password or customer record. entry.summary: There are now dozens of credible AI coding assistants, and every one of them will show you a demo where it writes a working function in seconds. The demo is the easy part.
